Current tools include:

claims.question: q3
claims.claim: Business rules remain in application code; the LLM reasons about what needs to happen while deterministic code decides what is allowed.
claims.quote:
Business rules remain in application code.

The LLM can reason about **what needs to happen**; deterministic code decides **what is actually allowed to happen**.
